[P2] Keep the conformance API compatible with the provider stack

The lockfile now installs API 1.10.0 inside this package while the plugin and OTel 2.12.0 provider stack retain API 1.9.1 and require `<1.10.0`. With a provider registered through that stack, API 1.10 cannot access the older global registration. Consequently, `recordUserFunctionSpan()` sees no active context and the user-function/callback-context scenarios fail. The package’s local tests only check typing and wiring, so they miss this runtime failure. Retain a bounded 1.9.x API dependency and refresh the lockfile, or upgrade and validate the provider stack together.
